data.exact_reserve_text: Overall, the strong current accident year performance, offset by the back year reserve strengthening, has resulted in a claims ratio for the Syndicate of 54% for the year. whilst in general prior year reserves continue to hold up well there have been two very specific accounts that have required reserve strengthening. increased notifications on the New Zealand earthquake claims have required strengthening of reserves on prior years, leading to a more modest (but still better than plan) 87% combined ratio for the year. Professional Indemnity ("PI") - particularly the UK Solicitors' Professional Indemnity account, which has required some additional reserve strengthening on the older Years of Account have proven more problematic.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced overall back year reserve strengthening in 2014, primarily driven by increased notifications on New Zealand earthquake claims and additional strengthening required for the UK Solicitors' Professional Indemnity account. The emergence of the Talisman claim also contributed to losses attaching to historic years of account. While the current accident year performance was strong, these prior year adverse developments led to an overall strengthening of reserves.
